results.rationale: The fabric backdrop remains, but the cube side colors change from blue/orange to red/orange and existing top tiles are rearranged. The edited cube still has a conspicuous upper-front cavity, so it is not completed. Uneven tile rows and distorted joins create noticeable geometric flaws.

The supplied source is an identifiable fountain pen, which is retained with its black barrel and gold trim while the explicitly requested background is redesigned. A bear, blue gradient, clouds, stars and candy appear, but the title is garbled rather than Bear Balloon Party. The colorful poster is coherent apart from its conspicuously malformed lettering.
